content:
Minol Acid And Chemicals P. Ltd. stands as a prominent chemical manufacturing company strategically located in the heart of Baroda, Gujarat, one of India's most industrially vibrant regions. Situated at 102 Sudhan Apartment, opposite Tejas School on Race Course, Baroda-7, the company has established itself as a reliable supplier of high-quality acids and chemical products to diverse industries across India.

Founded with a vision to meet the growing demands of the chemical sector, Minol Acid And Chemicals has built its reputation on the pillars of quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction. The company specializes in the production and distribution of various industrial acids and specialty chemicals that serve as essential raw materials for numerous manufacturing processes. Their product portfolio caters to industries including textiles, pharmaceuticals, agriculture, metal treatment, and water treatment, among others.

Operating from Gujarat, often referred to as the "Growth Engine of India," Minol benefits from the state's excellent infrastructure, business-friendly policies, and proximity to major ports. This strategic location enables efficient distribution networks and seamless supply chain management. The company's commitment to maintaining stringent quality standards, coupled with its technical expertise and customer-centric approach, has helped it forge long-lasting partnerships with clients across various sectors. Minol Acid And Chemicals continues to evolve with changing market dynamics while maintaining its core values of integrity, safety, and environmental responsibility.
